correctness.rationale: The finite law is proved by factorial moments of [z^n](2zC(z))^k, with separate all-short boundary; the exact marginal mass plus product bound proves a Rayleigh limit. Uniform hypergeometric CLT for k of order sqrt(n) and moment convergence imply the conditional Gaussian mixture and correlation constant. Exact exhaustive balanced-word and Catalan coefficient assertions corroborate the proof; none are used as infinite proof.
